_comment: MANUAL COHORT EXCEPTIONS. Standard (0 order-level-discount) invoices that DataSync is failing to sync properly, so OUR code owns them instead — builds/maintains the Xero invoice AND mirrors payments back to HubSpot, exactly like a real cohort (discount>0) invoice.
